calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  rc.fiscal_year,
  rc.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rc ON (
  f.sale_date >= rc.period_start_date 
  AND f.sale_date <= rc.period_end_date 
  AND f.sale_date >= (SELECT fiscal_year_start_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = rc.fiscal_year LIMIT 1)
)
WHERE rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND rc.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY rc.fiscal_year, rc.fiscal_period
ORDER BY rc.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  rc.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rc ON (
  f.sale_date >= rc.period_start_date 
  AND f.sale_date <= rc.period_end_date
)
WHERE rc.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND rc.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY rc.fiscal_period, f.channel_code

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON (f.sale_date = d.calendar_date)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON (f.sale_date = d.calendar_date)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_records,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_channel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS distinct_receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON (f.sale_date = d.calendar_date)
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 8
